title: FAQ: Diamond Elite Account
summary: This document is the FAQ for the Diamond Elite Account. It states a 7.5% APY, a $250,000 minimum balance, $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, dedicated private banker service, complimentary advisory, invitations to exclusive events, and waived wire transfer fees; it also offers 20% estate planning discounts through partner providers.
